props.text:
Market psychology on sweep opportunities: when significant highs/lows swept, emotions peak, sentiment becomes one-sided, targets raised/lowered. That's where opportunity lives.

I am patiently waiting for a significant sweep of the highs for my $BTC hedge short.

Reinforces structural HTF sweep-of-highs thesis for existing hedge short (73.6–74.9K entry Aug 21). Chart shows recurring sweep pattern validation across multiple cycles.
